verdict.rationale: Secureframe publishes an llms.txt at its site root (secureframe.com/llms.txt) and serves markdown variants of pages such as pricing.md, so an agent can be pointed at agent-oriented docs directly. The MCP docs page and the machine-readable OpenAPI spec embedded in the API reference add further agent-consumable material. Missing for 10: evidence of what the llms.txt actually covers (only a single marketing snippet is quoted), a standalone raw OpenAPI download, and independent or hands-on corroboration that agents use these docs effectively.
